image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a large bagel sandwich on a white plate. The bagel has a golden-brown, glossy crust with a visible central hole. It is sliced horizontally and filled with a creamy white spread (likely cream cheese or coleslaw) and other ingredients. The background shows a wooden desk surface with papers, a black cable, and a red plastic utensil.
